frozen_at_commit_scope: WO-NL4-001 (EX-NL4-001-R1); changes require a new allowlist revision + new Work Order

propose_candidate.description: register a candidate parameter set for evaluation; validated against candidate_params before any execution

request_run.description: ask the controller to execute one previously proposed candidate; consumes simulation/wall budget only on actual execution

read_analysis.description: read the analysis records published so far in this session; read-only, consumes no budget

seed.seed_policy: frozen E2 replica seed triple (E2_PROTO_R1 §3); one seed per run; a candidate is uniquely identified by (variant, steps, seed) and re-executing an identical candidate is rejected by the controller as CANDIDATE_ALREADY_RUN; the same seed on a different variant or length is legitimate (as in the E2 parametric series)

max_simulations.description: hard cap on executed runs per goal; excess request_run actions are rejected, never executed

max_wall_minutes.description: hard cap on cumulative executor wall time per goal; a run that would exceed it is rejected before execution

forbidden.unknown_actions: any action key outside actions is rejected with ACTION_NOT_IN_ALLOWLIST
forbidden.unknown_candidate_fields: any candidate field outside {variant, steps, seed} is rejected with FORBIDDEN_CANDIDATE_FIELD
forbidden.engine_access: the agent never invokes the simulation engine directly; only the controller talks to the ExecutorAdapter
forbidden.gate_tampering: integrity gates are frozen in scoring.py from E2_PROTO_R1 §4 and cannot be proposed or modified by any action
